findings.highlight: I grab onto the chain so that it won't let me go.
findings.evidenceJa: 決して離れないよう鎖を掴み
findings.governingReading: He deliberately reverses his prior resistance, winds the chain deeply, and grips it so the two cannot separate.
findings.explanation: Shirou gripping the chain so he will not let go becomes the chain refusing to release him.
